basic_info.description: Step into this unique home with amazing character and great space.  On two levels, this home is on a quiet street and also has wonderful outdoor space in a rustic setting with tremendous light. The main level of this home features three bedrooms, a spacious bathroom, and a terrific rear-open kitchen and living area with beam ceilings.  Descending the interior staircase to the lower level is another terrific living space, including a media room, a sleeping alcove, a bathroom and a room perfect for an office or artist's studio.  Both levels have direct access to the mature private garden, and there is a wonderful deck off the main level's living area. In addition, large windows on all four sides on the main level, especially the kitchen/living area that has views of backyard and Twin Peaks.  The lower level also has windows on three sides.  There is radiant floor heat throughout the home.  This is a great location near all that Potrero Hill has to offer, near the 101 and 280 freeways, and close to trendy Mission and all the terrific shopping and restaurants.
